note.question: How does an optimization framework that use financial risk concepts to capture the above goals and uncertainties, and apply it to a real forestry problem in Finland?
note.overview: The timing of forest stands harvesting is an important operational decision in forestry. Major goals of private nonindustrial forest owners are to achieve a steady flow of profits while reaching an overall satisfactory and reliable profit level. These goals are pursued under uncertainties in the growth of trees in different regions and in the prices of wood products.
